title: [CI] Fold report tools into main build and publish packaged apps in one MSBuild call

review.body_prefix:
### Qualified review assessment

The current change folds both report tools into the main solution and replaces seven separate packaging publishes with one parallel MSBuild task. The package imports, documented restore prerequisite, installer build path and aggregate child-property forwarding were traced against the current revision.

The previously raised path-separator and cache-token concerns do not establish regressions: `RepoRoot` is assigned from `MSBuildThisFileDirectory`, and the main build retains its conditional caching/token setup. The former publish calls did not carry that token setup either. The installer still builds the main solution unless `SkipBuild` explicitly assumes existing outputs. Earlier executable checks would improve diagnostics, but no missing payload was demonstrated.

**Validation scope:** Eight focused checks passed on this current revision: the repository ARM64 configuration verifier for the main and two standalone solutions, the unchanged aggregate Publish task against seven fixture projects for Debug/Release and x64/ARM64, and the expected missing-child failure. These exercise configuration mapping, task dispatch and forwarded properties, not compilation of the report tools or publication of the real applications.

**Remaining qualification:** Full dependency restore, real application publishing and the complete packaging pipeline were not executed. No production-code defect is asserted from the assessed concerns; this is a bounded assessment with explicit validation gaps, not unconditional approval.
